retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban luxury aesthetic featuring three subjects framed by massive 3D gold medallions and intricate baroque filigree.

recipe.visualDefinition: A maximalist digital collage centered on three figures standing atop a large gold coin, framed by a circular Greek-key medallion and a square baroque border, utilizing heavy 3D gold textures and high-gloss finishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects positioned between a foreground 3D title and a background circular medallion
Gold textures unify disparate photographic elements
Circular geometry of the medallions contrasts with the square outer filigree frame
High-key lighting on subjects against a dark, ornate background
coreInvariants: Polished gold metallic texture with specular highlights
Ornate damask or baroque filigree in the outer corners
3D beveled depth on all primary graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three central figures in mid-shot, scaled to fit within the diameter of the background medallion.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 3D gold acronym in the lower third, acting as a base for the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left vertical text, moves to the central figures, and drops to the heavy 3D title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with patterns and metallic objects.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright White and Red (from subject clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between glowing gold elements and dark background; high saturation in metallic highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy 3D extrusion with a 45-degree downward perspective
Multi-layered beveled edges with inner 'inline' grooves
Extreme vertical elongation for secondary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' features a wide, deep fork
The 'R' has a squared-off leg and a large counter
The 'N' uses thick vertical pillars with a sharp diagonal
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between ultra-bold 3D block lettering and ultra-thin vertically stretched serifs.

preserve: Vertical stretch of the top-left text

candidateDirections.reason: Base skeleton for the large 3D acronym before extrusion.
Approximate for the vertically stretched serif in the top left.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, ornate background with a square baroque filigree border. In the center, place a large, glowing gold circular medallion featuring a Greek-key pattern. At the bottom, place a large 3D gold coin tilted in perspective to serve as a floor. Position three men in urban streetwear standing on the coin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D beveled gold acronym across the lower third, resting on the coin. Add vertically stretched, thin gold serif text in the top-left corner. Apply lens flares to the metallic edges.

verificationChecks: Is the gold texture consistent across all graphic elements?
Does the central text have a clear 3D depth and bevel?
Is the Greek-key pattern visible on the circular medallion?
Is the background dark enough to make the gold pop?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any unique brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean 3D extrusion on the main title.
Ensure the Greek-key pattern is not distorted.
Verify the subjects appear integrated into the 3D space.
Confirm the vertical text is legible despite the stretch.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] with [3D Gold Medallion] and [Baroque Border] using [High-Gloss Metallic Texture] and [3D Beveled Typography].
